title: Polynomial-Time Comparison of Encoded Integers
statement: Encode a pair of bit strings by doubling each bit of the first string, appending the separator $01$, and then appending the second string. Parse an input at aligned pairs from the left, treating $00$ and $11$ as doubled bits of the first string and the first $01$ as the separator; if parsing fails, take both decoded strings to be empty. Interpret each decoded string as a binary numeral with its first bit least significant. The function that returns the one-bit string $1$ when the first decoded value is strictly less than the second, and $0$ otherwise, is computable in polynomial time.
